LABUAN COMPANIES ACT 1990

LABUAN COMPANIES (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 146(1) of
the Labuan Companies Act 1990 [ Act 441], the Minister, on the recommendation of
the Authority, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Labuan Companies (Amendment)
Regulations 2022.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2023.

Substitution of Third Schedule
2.  The Labuan Compani es Regulations 2010 [ P.U. (A) 414/2010 ] are amended by
substituting for the Third Schedule the following schedule:
